citations.text: Efklides, A., & Schwartz, B. L. (2024). Revisiting the Metacognitive and Affective Model of Self-Regulated Learning: Origins, Development, and Future Directions. Educational Psychology Review, 36, 61.

en.general: In MASRL, emotions and moods form a separate system with its own regulation, linked in both directions to metacognition. The article places the regulation of effort inside this system. Boredom lowers effort, and a feeling of difficulty can raise it or end it.

examples: Boredom lowering the effort a student puts in.
Re-appraising a task to feel less negative and keep working.
nonExamples: A judgment that an answer is correct.
